Gemini vs VEXI: Chat AI or Social Media Done in One App?
Gemini writes, makes images and generates video clips in a chat. VEXI edits your own footage, designs and posts it for you, and Autopilot runs your week.
People make content with Gemini plus a stack of other apps. Here is what that stack takes, next to one app that does the whole job.

Gemini is Google's chat AI. It writes captions and social copy, makes and edits images, and on paid plans generates video clips in the app, with more in Flow. Plans run from $0, through AI Plus at $4.99 and AI Pro at $19.99 a month, to AI Ultra from $99.99 a month.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The difference is what happens after the clip. Gemini generates; it does not edit the footage you shot into a finished post, and its plans list no posting to your social accounts. You download, edit, caption and schedule in other apps. VEXI is service as software: you ask once, and the post comes back written, designed, edited and scheduled. VEXI costs more than Gemini: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Gemini makes new clips from a prompt. Turning the videos you filmed into a cut with B-roll, music and captions happens in another editor.
Send VEXI the clips you shot and they come back cut, with B-roll, music and captions, sized for each platform.
Gemini's plans list no posting or scheduling to your social accounts. That means another app, set up and paid for on the side.
VEXI schedules and posts to your connected accounts itself.
Every Post Starts With You Asking
A chat answers when you ask. Planning a week of posts and getting each one out on time is still on you.
VEXI Autopilot runs your week ahead: it writes, cuts and posts, and can wait for your approval on everything.
Gemini's Trustpilot profile is rated 1.4. Some reviewers report wrong answers given with confidence and videos with spelling errors in their text.
Edits your own footage: cuts, B-roll, music, captions
Chat AI • Images + Video Clips • No Posting
A strong chat AI with video generation at a low price. It does not turn your own footage into a finished post or post anything, so the edit and the scheduling are still yours to assemble.
One app: you ask, and it writes, designs, edits the video and posts it. Autopilot runs your week ahead.
Can Gemini make social media videos?

On paid plans, Gemini generates video clips from a prompt, and it writes captions and social copy. Editing the clips you filmed into a finished post with B-roll, music and captions happens in another editor.
Can Gemini post to my social accounts?
Gemini's plans list no posting or scheduling to your social accounts. VEXI posts to your connected accounts itself, on a schedule or on Autopilot.
What does a Gemini content stack cost?

Priced monthly: Gemini AI Pro $19.99 for the words and clips, CapCut Pro $19.99 for the edit, Canva Pro $18 for the covers and Buffer $15 to schedule comes to about $73 a month across four subscriptions. That is cheaper than VEXI. What you pay VEXI for is the work in between: the prompts, the files, the edit and the posting.
What do Trustpilot reviewers say about Gemini?
Gemini's Trustpilot profile is rated 1.4. Some reviewers report wrong answers given with confidence, low-effort output, and videos with spelling errors in their text.
